item.title: fix(doctor): point legacy model refs at doctor --fix (#125660)
item.summary: fix(doctor): point legacy model refs at doctor --fix (#125660) The model-reference check told operators to install a plugin or configure models.providers for a retired provider like openai-codex, which would recreate a route the architecture deliberately removed, while doctor --fix already migrates the ref losslessly. Ask the migration owner whether it would rewrite the ref and, when it would, name the target and the repair command.
